close_reason: All revocation epic issues complete: Error enum, CrlChecker, OcspChecker
description:
Implement the pkix-revocation crate: define its own Error type, implement CrlChecker (offline), implement OcspChecker (offline).

BLOCKED BY: Epic PKIX-cfh (PKIX-b9z in particular — RevocationChecker must return pkix_revocation::Result before this epic can proceed).

Error type (pkix_revocation::Error):
  Revoked { serial: SerialNumber, reason_code: Option<u8> }
  CrlExpired { this_update: ... , next_update: ... }
  CrlSignatureInvalid
  OcspSignatureInvalid
  OcspStatusUnknown
  ParseError(der::Error)
  The error type needs Display and std::error::Error (behind std feature) per PKIX-e9v.

CrlChecker (crl feature flag):
  Input: caller provides DER-encoded CRL bytes at construction time (offline — no network).
  On check_revocation:
    1. Parse CRL using x509-cert (or der directly — confirm x509-cert has CRL types)
    2. Verify CRL signature against issuer SPKI from the issuer Certificate argument
    3. Check thisUpdate <= now and now <= nextUpdate (need time passed in — design TBD)
    4. Look up cert serial number in revokedCertificates list
    5. Return Ok(()) if not found, Err(Revoked { ... }) if found
  Test vectors: generate with openssl ca -gencrl and openssl ca -revoke. Commit as DER fixtures.

OcspChecker (ocsp feature flag):
  Input: caller provides DER-encoded OCSP response bytes at construction time.
  On check_revocation:
    1. Parse OCSP BasicOCSPResponse
    2. Verify responder signature
    3. Check producedAt validity window
    4. Match cert by issuerNameHash + issuerKeyHash + serialNumber
    5. Return based on CertStatus (good/revoked/unknown)
  Note: x509-ocsp crate version TBD (see workspace.dependencies TODO comment)
  Test vectors: generate with openssl ocsp. Commit as DER fixtures.

Sub-issues to create:
1. Define pkix_revocation::Error enum with Display
2. CRL parsing and signature verification helper
3. CrlChecker implementation + test vectors
4. OcspChecker implementation + test vectors
5. pkix-chain integration: wire revocation into verify_chain with correct pkix_chain::Error

Acceptance: CrlChecker and OcspChecker pass against OpenSSL-generated test vectors. pkix-chain::verify_chain returns pkix_chain::Error properly.
